snippet.title: Pixel Pirate - iOS and Google Play Release Trailer - New Mobile Game!
snippet.description:
Pixel Pirate offers a unique reaction and timing based gameplay experience, featuring retro pixel graphics. 

Out now on iOS and Google Play!
GOOGLE PLAY: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.SeawolfStudios.PixelPirate
iOS LINK: https://apple.co/2mZGCc8

Music by Rolemusic - 
https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Rolemusic
License - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Music has been edited to fit the trailer.

FIGHT hordes of undead enemies.
UNLOCK pirate characters.
EXPAND your arsenal of weapons.
COLLECT cursed gold.
UNIQUE pixel art style.

Pixel Pirate is created by Seawolf Studios, a two 
person team with no prior experience in game development, but a passion for fun, quality games.

Apple, the Apple logo, iPhone, and iPad are trademarks of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries and regions. App Store is a service mark of Apple Inc.
